name: Tactile Unguent
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 5th; Slot —; Price 250 gp; Weight —

DESCRIPTION

Cat burglars, gear workers, locksmiths, and even street performers often use this gooey substance, for it increases the sensitivity of your hands. Any tactile Perception checks, Sleight of Hand checks, or Disable Device checks receive a +10 competence bonus for 1 hour.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Special creator must possess 5 ranks in the following skills: Disable Device, Perception, Sleight of Hand; Cost 125 gp
